name: codex-gardener
description: Promote repeated Codex task lessons at the right scope, from one repository to every project.

interface.shortDescription: Promote reusable knowledge at the right scope.
interface.longDescription: Capture lessons from real Codex tasks, distinguish repository-specific knowledge from portable global knowledge, aggregate independent evidence, and safely promote proven guidance at the narrowest valid scope.
defaultPrompt: Review this completed task and capture reusable knowledge at the right scope.
Curate repository and global learning candidates.
Coordinate this cross-project change in the repository that owns it.
